verdict.rationale: Pulumi exposes a documented Automation API for programmatic control without the CLI, a CLI with structured JSON output suitable for agent parsing (verified hands-on in probe-6/7), and an official MCP server explicitly built for AI assistants to query resources and run commands (verified via live handshake in probe-8). While there's no traditional REST/OpenAPI endpoint (probe-3 confirms 404s), these documented, working programmatic interfaces satisfy the AI-native driving story.
